```{r}
here::i_am("Charm-Prices.Rproj")
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```


##oil and exchange rate 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

brent <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "DCOILBRENTEU.csv"), na = c("", "."))
fx    <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "DEXUSEU.csv"),       na = c("", "."))

glimpse(brent)
glimpse(fx)
```
```{r}
oil <- tibble(date = seq(as.Date("2020-12-01"), as.Date("2023-12-31"), by = "day")) %>%
  left_join(brent %>% rename(date = 1), by = "date") %>%
  left_join(fx %>% rename(date = 1), by = "date") # building a calendar for evryday, and attaching each oil and exchange rate to a day 
```



```{r}
oil <- oil %>%
  fill(DCOILBRENTEU, DEXUSEU, .direction = "down") %>%
  filter(date >= as.Date("2021-01-01"))
```




```{r}
oil <- oil |>
  mutate(brent_eur_l = DCOILBRENTEU / DEXUSEU / 158.987)

summary(oil$brent_eur_l)
```
```{r}
dir.create(here("data", "clean"), showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(oil, here("data", "clean", "oil.csv"))
```
